summary: Example task configures L3 interfaces on IOS with ios_l3_interfaces using config and a chosen state.
questions: How do I configure L3 interfaces on Cisco IOS with a resource module?

answer_card.title: Configure L3 interfaces on IOS
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: configure l3 interface
  cisco.ios.ios_l3_interfaces:
    config: "{{ config }}"
    state: merged   # or replaced, overridden, deleted
```
